patches.purpose: Provide each Midi-created template, summon, and transform cleanup ActiveEffect with a fresh id, top-level base type, and changes-only system data so dnd5e 6 migration cannot mistake missing ids for status ids.
Restore a dnd5e 6 ChatMessage item through the already-bound Activity or native scaled chat-card association before legacy flag lookup, preserving older dnd5e behavior and missing-item diagnostics.
Before dnd5e 6 calculates a damage target row, render unresolved or actorless non-token targets as visibly unavailable and non-interactive so they cannot abort the damage tray.
Give only the default dnd5e 6 enchantment-application clone a fresh ActiveEffect ID so id-less status migrations cannot misclassify it, while preserving caller types and explicit clone contexts.
Give only id-less non-condition ActiveEffects created on dnd5e 6 a fresh ID before source migration, preserving explicit IDs, condition migration, non-creation paths, and other system majors.

In dnd5e 6 manual APPLY mode, defer DAE isDamaged expiry until the own Midi damage tray confirms a positive post-write HP or temp HP loss; leave typed expiry pending exact per-type contribution proof.
